study type: Quality Improvement Initiative / Pre-post Intervention Audit
exposure: Education sessions for anaesthetic recovery and ward staff
Introduction of a new preprinted and highlighted medication chart (employing Nudge Theory principles)
outcome: Compliance with guidelines for administration of analgesic medications
cohort: The study participants were patients undergoing Caesarean section operations.
finding: The combined approach significantly improved the rate of administration of analgesic drugs in compliance with guidelines, rising from 39.6% to 89.9%.
